rows.en:
Don't be silly…

Try going into that café over there and saying stuff like "Shocker showed up," or "DARK's Destruction Squad…," or something about space crime syndicates!

I doubt anyone would take you seriously… but suppose they did believe you, what then? The whole world would be in a huge panic, with people running around in every direction.

Oh… I guess you're right.

We're not… ordinary high-school students anymore, are we?
That's right… No midterms or finals, none of those annoying school rules. Nobody ranking us by our test scores.
And all that's… thanks to the Vol cells, huh?
Well… whether it turned out good or bad, the point is to enjoy the here and now…
I am enjoying it! I'm with you, [HERO2]…
That said… it is kind of sad, I guess.
Why? Being with me?

No! This, this right here!

"Another Specialist Scientist Kidnapped!? Crisis Management Called into Question!!" "Evil Organizations Run Rampant! Japan Defenseless!" it says…

Unicorn and SSI, with their flashy giant robots, get all the cheers, while we in the Amigo Squad just keep getting bashed.
No way! But we in the Amigo Squad… are trying super hard!

I know, right?

"Affiliated with UCMA, the international crisis-management military alliance"… it just doesn't ring a bell for anyone, does it? I guess it can't be helped, since it's not a public organization…

But you know… the fact that there's a news site like that is proof Earth is still at peace…

Hey, hey… why do guys love giant robots like these so much?

They're just a wig monster and a fire engine, aren't they? You like them too, don't you, [HERO2]? Hey, hey, which one do you like?
"The wig monster?" "The fire engine?" "Or… me?"
"Sorry, it's Giant Robo!" "Hahaha… Red Baron, of course."
Calling it a wig monster is going too far! Whatever you do, don't say that in front of Daisaku!!
I know… I don't mean anything bad by it.
Anyway, I like Giant Robo, with its remote control. Just once, I'd like to…
Look, look, a giant robot showed up! You like those, right?
Idiot! Does that look like it's on our side!?
But… they all look the same to me.
Calling it a fire engine is going too far! Whatever you do, don't say that in front of Ken. It's a keepsake from his brother!

Anyway, I like Red Baron.

The real thrill of a giant robot is piloting it, after all! Just once, I'd like to…
Look, look… it's one of those giant robots you love, [HERO2]!

Huh?

[HERO2]!!

…As if we could ever end up like that! We're cousins! [HERO2], you dummy! So, what's the real answer?

Huh?

Hey… take what I'm saying seriously!
Is it BF? Or could it be the Iron Mask Party?
We can't handle this on our own… [HERO2]!!

Anyway, let's get back to Dr. Yajima's lab!

But… what is that robot attacking? What could be in that spot?
So that's the artificial brain?
It's awfully small, isn't it?
What can it do?

This is the first artificial brain this small in the world, isn't it?

Come to think of it… it's the complete opposite of Brain, the world's largest artificial brain, which vanished in that mysterious attack a year ago.
Dr. Yajima… what kind of capabilities does it have?

You may think of this artificial brain of mine as an ultra-miniaturized computer.

This rabbit has been fitted with an artificial brain.

Thanks to it, this rabbit can fully understand all human language.
Really!?
Is that even possible?
No way!? A rabbit?
That's really hard to believe.

Another feature of this artificial brain is that it can make full use of the animal's natural traits!

Until now, this rabbit could jump only about 1 meter, but with the artificial brain it can easily jump 5 meters.
That's ridiculous!?
Don't pull our leg.
Then, Doctor… show us, please.

………

Big jump!!
Whoa!? That's really something…
Wow, I'm amazed! Dr. Yajima, the experiment is a huge success!
But… if it were implanted in a human, there'd be serious trouble…
What's wrong? Why the scary face?
Gel-Shocker is bound to go after this.
Gel-Shocker is bound to go after this.
I see… Now that you mention it, you're right.
Speak of the devil! Here they are already!
Enemies detected!! It's Gel-Shocker.

Gel-Shocker! What are they plotting?

…!?
…!? Hayato, Taki?
…!? Hongo, Taki?
[HERO2]! [HERO4]! Big trouble! The venue for Dr. Yajima's research press conference has been attacked!
They came to steal Dr. Yajima's artificial intelligence!
They came to steal Dr. Yajima's artificial intelligence!
Then… don't tell me that robot belongs to… Gel-Shocker?

…!?

What's that?

…!?

What's that?
This is serious. I'll check with the TDF just in case! I'm leaving this to you.
Please be careful, Taki.

…!?

Gel-Shocker!? Why are they here?
[HERO2]! [HERO4]! Big trouble! The venue for Dr. Yajima's research press conference has been attacked!
Be careful, Taki.
Which organization does this robot belong to? BF? The Iron Mask Party? Well, Captain Kiriyama?
Sir… Dr. Sahara says it's an invasion weapon belonging to an organization called the Brain Party.
The Brain Party? What makes you say that, Dr. Sahara?
Well… there are signs that Professor Hustler may be the mastermind.

Professor Hustler?

No, but… didn't Professor Hustler go missing in that mysterious laboratory attack a year ago?

In truth, it was Brain and Professor Hustler who formed the Brain Party.

And the underground laboratory now under attack was a top-secret location known only to those of commander rank among us.
In other words… Professor Hustler, who knew of the location, is the suspect?
That's right…
But… Brain is an artificial brain, isn't it? Does an artificial brain build invasion weapons?

Brain is the largest artificial brain in the world.

To protect people all over the world from every kind of disaster, it worked at the science laboratory of the International Peace Organization, also known as the Red Muffler Squad.

Its role was to predict abnormal weather and earthquakes around the world ahead of time, and work out countermeasures.

But Professor Hustler had another purpose in mind…
Another purpose?
Developing invasion weapons using the artificial brain.
Invasion weapons!? An artificial brain can build such things?

uncertain: U03702/U03705/U03711: カツラお化け (wig monster, Giant Robo) and 消防自動車 (fire engine, Red Baron) teasing nicknames kept literal.
U03703/U03704: choice menus stored as narration; rendered as quoted options.
U03714: [HERO4] fantasizes then denies it ('We're cousins'); the hero and heroine are cousins per this line.
U03748: 人工知能 (artificial intelligence) used here vs 人工頭脳 (artificial brain) elsewhere; kept the distinction as written.
